6. Enter the 8 digit code that you received in your email and click: SUBMIT

content.text: Enroll MFA via an application that requires MFA

items.text: Provide your MyNCID username and password on an application that requires login.

If you have a phone number listed on your MyNCID profile, you will get the following options: **Authenticator, or email.** (You will only see SMS and phone call option if you have a phone number registered in your MyNCID profile)
Select one option, enter the 8 digit you received on your selected method and click: Submit
If your OTP is accepted, you will be directed to your application.
